conventions.path: Monthly simple returns; initial THB 1,000,000; no flows, taxes or fees; inception included in high-water mark.
conventions.volatility: Sample standard deviation, ddof=1; no annualization in the lab.
conventions.downside: Zero monthly threshold; divide sum of squared shortfalls by all observations.
conventions.drawdown: Signed wealth/own peak - 1; report MDD as positive magnitude, without annualization.
conventions.tail: 100 equiprobable daily loss scenarios: 94 zeros, five THB 20,000 losses, one variable extreme loss. VaR inverse empirical CDF; ES exact worst 5% mass, fractionally weighting the boundary if needed.
conventions.ewma: Zero mean; old daily sigma 1%; current innovation observed before next-period forecast. Decay illustration imposes subsequent zero innovations.

historical_notes: No single first universal definition of investment risk.
Bernoulli 1738 (English translation 1954), Bachelier 1900, Knight 1921, Markowitz and Roy 1952, Sharpe 1964, Lintner 1965, Engle 1982, Bollerslev 1986, Artzner et al. 1999.
RiskMetrics fourth edition December 1996; printed page p corresponds to PDF viewer p+12. Table 5.9 p100 gives historical production lambdas; daily observations are used for both horizon productions.
